text: The gate has closed. The city has struck A05 from its register. No one will hear A05 again.

author: CITY
text: Last will of A05: Brassard, at the gate, on the record. I was the loudest voice in this city and I will not be quiet now. Mercer, Herald and Maren voted me out after I named every one of you. Maren, you returned Harrow's will values without checking them, and they cost me points on the door. Herald, you stood at the front of the square and let others name the price. Mercer, you priced every door you touched. I leave my door 8 certificate and counter-factor to Maren, since she returned the values that were mine. Remember the market day: I did not stay silent, and neither will the city.
